 REPRESENTED BY BRANCH MANAGER

Application praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed therewith the High Court be pleased to condone the delay of 123 days in filing the above appeal against the common award dated 07.05.2024 made in O.P.(MV) No.87/2022 on the file of the Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, Muvattupuzha, in the interest of justice.

This Application coming on for orders upon perusing the application and the affidavit filed in support thereof, and upon hearing the arguments of M/S. A.R.NIMOD & M.A.AUGUSTINE, Advocates for the applicant and Standing Counsel for the respondent No.2, the Court passed the following:
 P.T.O  C. PRATHEEP KUMAR, J  -----------------------------------------------
 C.M.Appl. No.1 of 2025  in  MACA.No.99 of 2025  ------------------------------------------------

Dated this the 07th day of February, 2025 Lucy Joseph vs Mahesh V.C on 7 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/51439925/
1  ORDER
This is an application filed by the appellant praying for condoning the delay of 123 days in filing the appeal.
2. The application was opposed on the ground that sufficient ground was not stated for condoning the delay.
3. The petitioner filed the above appeal claiming enhancement of compensation in respect of injuries sustained in a motor vehicle accident.

Considering the fact that this appeal related to claim for compensation under the provisions of Motor Vehicles Act, I hold that the delay of 123 days in filing the appeal can be condoned on condition that the petitioner shall waive the interest for the enhanced amount of compensation awarded, if any, for the period of delay in filing the appeal.
4. In the result, this application is allowed on condition that the petitioner will not be eligible for interest for the enhanced amount of compensation, if any, in appeal.
MACA Appeal is admitted.
The learned Standing Counsel takes notice for the 2 nd respondent.
Policy is admitted, hence notice to the 1st respondent is dispensed with.
The learned counsel for the appellant is directed to serve a copy of the appeal memorandum to the learned Standing Counsel.
Post after two months for settlement.

Sd/-
 C. PRATHEEP KUMAR,
 JUDGE 07-02-2025  SMA /True Copy/ Assista Lucy Joseph vs Mahesh V.C on 7 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/51439925/
2
